agyos_skill.intent: Search, inspect, and download design assets from Iconscout's library of 15M+ icons, vector illustrations, 3D icons, and Lottie animations via its MCP server. Use natural language queries to find style-consistent assets and inject them directly into codebases and design files.
agyos_skill.instructions: Access Iconscout's 15M+ asset library — icons, vector illustrations, 3D icons, and Lottie animations — through its hosted MCP server. Search in natural language, inspect specs before committing, download in the right format, and find style-matched siblings to keep UI design consistent. **Endpoint:** `https://mcp.iconscout.com/mcp` **Auth:** OAuth browser sign-in (no manual API keys). Works with your existing Iconscout account — free and paid plan limits apply to downloads. **Clients:** Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Antigravity. | Tool | Purpose | |------|---------| | `search_assets` | Natural language search across all asset types with style/color/license filters | | `get_asset_details` | Fetch formats, dimensions, license tier, pack name, and contributor for any asset | | `download_assets` | Download a file in SVG, PNG, Lottie JSON, GIF, or MP4 to inject into the project | | `find_related_assets` | Find assets from the same visual pack/family for style consistency | | `browse_categories` | Navigate the category tree to refine broad concepts before searching | | Type | Formats | Best for | |------|---------|---------| | **Icons** | SVG, PNG | UI controls, navigation, status indicators | | **Illustrations** | SVG, PNG | Hero sections, empty states, onboarding flows | | **3D Icons** | PNG | Marketing pages, app store screenshots, landing pages | | **Lottie Animations** | JSON, GIF, MP4 | Micro-interactions, loading states, success/error feedback | 1. **Clarify the need** — confirm asset type (icon vs illustration vs Lottie), style (outline / filled / flat / 3D), color palette, and license constraint (free vs premium). 2. **Browse first if vague** — call `browse_categories` with a broad concept to land in the right classification before searching. 3. **Search with specifics** — call `search_assets` with a descriptive natural language query. Include style, orientation, and color explicitly: - ✅ `"outline style shopping cart icon, blue stroke, free"` - ✅ `"flat 3D rocket facing right, premium"` - ❌ `"icon"` (too vague) 4. **Inspect before download** — call `get_asset_details` to confirm format availability and license tier. Never download premium assets without user confirmation they have an active plan. 5. **Find siblings for consistency** — if the user is building a UI set, call `find_related_assets` on the first chosen asset to pull matching icons from the same pack.
